flashcard_questions.q: What age was Elizabeth when she became queen in 1558?
Which battle in 1485 brought the Tudor dynasty to the throne?
On what date was Elizabeth born?
Who was the mother of Elizabeth I?
What year was Anne Boleyn executed?
Who was Elizabeth's tutor, who admired her intelligence and dedication?
What advantage in diplomacy did Elizabeth's fluency in five languages give her?
flashcard_questions.a: She could negotiate directly with foreign ambassadors without translators

flashcard_questions.q: What age was Edward VI when he became king?
How many Protestants did Mary I burn at the stake in four years?
What nickname did Mary I earn for burning Protestants?
Which strict Protestants wanted a simple life based purely on the Bible?
What was Elizabeth's letter to Mary, begging her to believe her innocence, called?
Which powerful lord assaulted Elizabeth when she was about 13?
Who did Elizabeth appoint as her chief advisor on becoming queen?
Which settlement of 1559 aimed to end religious fighting by creating a middle ground?

notes: 15 cards: 6 person to significance, 4 event to date, 3 term to definition, 2 cause to effect. Turned the five-languages fact into a consequence card so the answer is not a list; dropped the Tower imprisonment to keep the Tide Letter card unique.
